basic_info.description:
Nestled in the heart of downtown San Francisco, this stunning condo offers an unbeatable combination of location, style, and convenience. Just steps from Chinatown, Union Square, and North Beach, it also provides easy access to the serenity of the San Francisco waterfront. Commuting is effortless with nearby Muni, BART, the Bay Bridge, and Highway 101 plus a dedicated parking spot included.
Inside, the stylish interior showcases exposed concrete, hardwood floors on the living level, and plush carpet in the lofted bedroom, creating a sophisticated blend of textures. The modern kitchen, featuring granite countertops and stainless-steel appliances, is designed to meet all your culinary needs.
Despite its central location, the building is set back from the main street, offering a peaceful retreat from the city's energy. Soaring two-story floor-to-ceiling windows bathe the space in natural light, while the Romeo and Juliet balcony invites fresh air and a seamless indoor-outdoor connection. Upstairs, a versatile alcove provides the perfect work-from-home setup, separate from the main bedroom-ideal for maintaining work-life balance.
Offering the best of urban convenience and modern tranquility, this home is a rare gem in the heart of San Francisco.
